Nothing more.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi wrenches his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, out of a corpse vision amidst the tombs of the Sith Lords, within an ancient mausoleum in the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban|<ref name="JQ:TFS">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>}}
A '''corpse vision''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]], akin to [[invoke spirits]], conjured through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] by a [[Sith sorcerer]], that summoned the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Dark Lords]] while playing upon the [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]] of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to produce [[Mind trick/Legends|mind-tricking]] visions. Under the Sith practitioner's spell, the corpses would metamorphose into intimate images from the Force-sensitive's past that would whisper twisted, potentially damaging messages to the recipient.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

==History==
{{Quote|You were always so afraid of disappointing me ... And you have."<br />''It's not real. It's not real.''<br />"You've failed me, Obi-Wan."<br />''Not ... real.''<br />"And you don't even know why.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi is afflicted by a corpse vision of Qui-Gon Jinn deep within an ancient Sith mausoleum in the Valley of the Dark Lords|<ref name="JQ:TFS" />}}
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], in alliance with [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban's]] dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Dark Lords]], employed mind-tricking corpse visions against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] coalition team [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|sent]] to Korriban to track down galactic criminals [[Granta Omega]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]. As the eight-member Jedi team entered the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], assaulting them on all sides were [[waves of darkness]], the oppressive effects of which required great effort to wade through and overcome. Entering the Valley's ancient mausoleums, the Jedi were simultaneously assaulted by dark-wave whispers and corpse visions amidst the [[Burial/Legends|tombs]] of the Sith Lords. The visions were summoned by the Sith Lord [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] in an effort to fend off the Jedi intrusion into the Valley, where he planned to rendezvous with Omega and Zan Arbor, to establish an "alliance" with them.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] experienced a corpse vision of his mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]] (accompanied by Sith whispers that ''it was the Jedi who kept him from her and the Jedi who took him away''), and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of his deceased [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] (who Sith-whispered that ''he had failed him''). The other Jedi experienced similar visions, after which they also encountered not only an undead platoon of [[Korriban zombie]]s, but also [[dark energy trap]]s, which they (with the exception of Skywalker) were able to stay clear of with Kenobi's advance warning.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />
